releases.notes:
## BUG FIX
- The issue of the sensitive information hiding button being unclickable has been resolved;
- The problem where items outside the scrolling screen still have click detection, causing buttons within the clickable area to become ineffective after scrolling, has been fixed;
- The issue where the tooltip for the local area network button may repeat five times when the user is not logged in has been addressed.

## Update
- New support for Malay language;
- Added the function of opening the Frpc folder on the Frpc update page.

## What's Changed
* New Crowdin updates by @zirran in https://github.com/StarCarefree/OpenLink/pull/78
